Public documentation, reports, security review or audit reports, mainnet deployments, published script hashes and schemas, and KPI reporting
request.recipient: Dano Finance, with Minswap Labs serving as budget administrator
request.what: Dano Finance requests treasury funding to accelerate the DeFi Kernel as an open standard for shared liquidity, on-chain financial intents, and global order-book coordination on Cardano, plus delivery of related DeFi primitives and SDK tooling.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 3,333,000 ADA total, consisting of 3,300,000 ADA for delivery and a 33,000 ADA 1% administration fee for Minswap Labs.
Dano Finance will deliver four work packages: a DeFi Kernel registry, a Spot Leverage Order Book, an American Options Protocol, and a Composable DeFi Transaction Builder SDK.
The DeFi Kernel is intended to be an open, fee-free, royalty-free compatibility standard for Cardano DeFi contracts that publish enough metadata for safe integration.
Dano Finance currently has approximately USD 18M in TVL and more than 10,000 on-chain transactions.
The Spot Leverage Order Book will support leveraged spot trading through orders coordinating collateral, borrowing, debt accounting, swap execution, risk parameters, and settlement.

The American Options Protocol will use an extended concentrated-pool model to support pool-priced American options with strike, expiry, premium, collateral, exercise, settlement, and LP risk accounting logic.
Smart contract workstreams include a security review or audit before mainnet release, and unresolved critical security issues block affected mainnet milestones.

The proposal sets KPIs including USD 1,000,000 rolling 30-day trading volume for the order book and USD 1,000,000 rolling 30-day option notional volume within 90 days of mainnet launch, measured using public on-chain data.

Dano Finance will return 5% of protocol fees generated by the treasury-funded Spot Leverage Order Book and American Options contracts for 12 months after mainnet launch, calculated after specified direct costs and reported publicly.
If delivered successfully, Cardano will gain better discoverability, stronger composability, deeper liquidity, improved developer experience, and more recurring on-chain activity.

summary: The document requests 3,333,000 ADA for Dano Finance to build a DeFi Kernel registry, two DeFi protocols, and an SDK, with Minswap Labs as budget administrator, milestone-based delivery, security-review conditions, public reporting, volume KPIs, and a 12-month 5% protocol-fee return commitment.
